verdict.rationale: Omnara's own docs say users can bring their own model keys for free. Agents can use models from OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, or Amazon Bedrock, or a compatible self-hosted model. Organizations connect providers, configure models, and grant them to projects, and custom model endpoints are available in the dashboard. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that BYO keys and custom endpoints work as claimed.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can bring my own LLM or API key so agents run on the model of my choice
